source.test: createSlot(name:for:...) reused as a recovery-snapshot archive — see docs/msc2/worlds/phase6-scope.md §"State 3 — both together", step 3, "Different, or equality cannot be established"

input.comparison_method: extract archive to scratch location, compare file-by-file: presence, size, and content hash

notes: phase6-scope.md State 3, step 3 (lines 68-69): when the live folders differ from the recorded active slot's archive -- or equality cannot be established at all (archive extraction fails, comparison is inconclusive) -- Phase 6 creates a recovery snapshot: the live folders are archived into a brand-new slot, distinct from and never overwriting the existing recorded slot's archive or metadata. The new snapshot becomes active, which is what 'preserve Phase 5's established live-world precedence' means in practice: the live folders are the freshest data Phase 5 actually imported, so they win the active slot going forward, while the previously-recorded slot survives untouched as an ordinary, selectable, non-active slot -- nothing reachable through MSC 1 before Phase 5 ran is deleted or hidden by this step, it just stops being the default.
